title: Campaign Manifest
description: Top-level descriptor for a campaign. References content packs, declares starting conditions, and sets global game rules.

id.description: Unique campaign identifier. Must begin with 'camp_' followed by lowercase alphanumeric and underscores.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the campaign.

engineVersion.description: Semantic version range the campaign requires (e.g. '>=0.2.0'). Uses npm semver syntax.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version this manifest conforms to (e.g. 'gm-rpg-v2.0').

description.description: Long-form summary of the campaign's narrative premise and scope.

author.description: Name of the campaign's author or design team.

genre.description: Genre tag such as 'Greek Mythology', 'Historical Fantasy', etc.

contentPacks.description: Ordered list of content packs that compose this campaign. Packs are loaded in declaration order.

id.description: Unique identifier of the content pack.

version.description: Exact version of the content pack required.

optional.description: If true, missing this pack emits a warning rather than an error.

startingConfig.description: Initial world state when a new game begins.

startLocationId.description: ID of the location where the player character begins the campaign.

startAdventureId.description: ID of the first adventure pack to activate on campaign start.

startingQuests.description: List of quest IDs that are immediately active when the campaign begins.

startingInventory.description: Items granted to the player character at campaign start.

quantity.description: Number of units of this item granted.

characterCreationOptions.description: Options for the character creation phase.

allowedOrigins.description: List of valid character origin/background IDs.

startingAttributePoints.description: Number of attribute points available to distribute during character creation.

allowNameInput.description: Whether the player can enter a custom character name.

settings.description: Global rule toggles for this campaign.

allowPlayerAttackNPCs.description: Whether the player may initiate combat against non-hostile NPCs.

allowNPCDeath.description: Whether NPCs marked isKillable can be permanently killed.

lootOnDeath.description: Whether defeated entities drop loot from their loot table.

permadeath.description: If true, player death ends the campaign run with no reload.

dependencies.description: External campaigns or data packages this campaign depends on.

version.description: Required version (semver range) of the dependency.

required.description: If false, the dependency is optional and its absence is non-fatal.
